title: Nourishing Charred Syrian Fish Skillet
description: A charred and tender Syrian dish featuring fromage frais, perfect for a lazy Sunday, this pescatarian friendly skillet is cooked to perfection on a tava griddle.
instructions: Preheat the tava griddle over medium high heat.
Season the fish fillets with salt, black pepper, and sumac.
Add olive oil to the preheated tava griddle and cook the fish fillets for 4 minutes per side.
Remove the fish from the tava griddle and set aside.
Add garlic to the tava griddle and cook for 1 minute.
Add fromage frais to the tava griddle and stir to combine with garlic.
Return the fish fillets to the tava griddle and spoon some of the fromage frais mixture over the top of each fillet.
Squeeze lemon juice over the fish fillets and sprinkle with parsley.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes and serve hot.
